summary: Pole L-4 lookout on Spread Mountain, Lolo NF; 1938 construction per newspapers (firelookout.com says 1935); planned use 1966-67; abandoned 1972, no longer standing.

facts.design: Pole tower with an L-4 cab
facts.status_note: Abandoned in 1972 and no longer standing, per firelookout.com.

events.note: Newspaper said a lookout was to be established at Spread Mountain. firelookout.com gives 1935 as the build year.
Lolo rangers planned three lookouts that summer, East Spread among them; construction under way by September 1938.
Listed as one of four fire lookouts in the Seeley Lake District (opinion column).
Listed among the 26 lookouts the Lolo planned to use that summer.
Abandoned; no longer standing per firelookout.com.

corrections.why: firelookout.com describes the built tower as a 20-foot pole. The 50-foot figure comes from a 1938 newspaper describing planned towers, not a confirmed built height. Editor should confirm before publishing.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: firelookout.com gives 1935. A 1935 newspaper item says a lookout was to be established at Spread Mountain, and 1938 items describe it being erected, with construction under way in September 1938. The story reports both dates; the newspaper timeline points to 1938 for construction.
firelookout.com gives a 20-foot pole. A 1938 newspaper item describes planned towers as 50 feet. No source confirms the built height.

notes_for_editor: No source gives access, so the access key is left out and the brief's 'unknown' stands. No source describes what remains on the site today. NGS listing ST0579 'EAST SPREAD LOOKOUT TOWER' is at 47 09 36 / 113 03 16, which matches the brief's coordinates, but its status codes are unclear, so it is not cited. The 2024 Seeley Swan Pathfinder item is an opinion column by a former seasonal worker. The 1967 list is a planned-use list, not a staffing record. Height correction (15.2 to 6.1 m) rests on firelookout.com's 20-foot wording; please confirm.
